select track_info.id trackId , track_info.track_title trackTitle , track_info.media_size mediaDuration , track_info.create_time createTime , track_info.order_num , max(if(track_stat.stat_type = '0701', track_stat.stat_num, 0)) playStatNum , max(if(track_stat.stat_type = '0704', track_stat.stat_num, 0)) albumCommentStatNum
from album_info join track_info on album_info.id = track_info.album_id join track_stat on track_info.id = track_stat.track_id where album_info.id = #{id} group by track_id order by order_num

select track_info.id trackId, track_title trackTitle, cover_url coverUrl, media_duration mediaDuration, sum(if(stat_type = '0701', stat_num, 0)) playStatNum, sum(if(stat_type = '0704', stat_num, 0)) albumCommentStatNum, track_info.create_time createTime, track_info.is_open isShowPaidMark from track_info join track_stat on track_info.id = track_stat.track_id where track_info.album_id = #{id} and track_info.is_deleted=0 group by track_info.id
